paragraphs.text: Ali Baba was a cunning rogue from Rabiah Ali Baba, a master of unlocking secrets and breaching defenses that others deemed impenetrable. With a simple utterance of "Open, Sesame!" , he could cause the most formidable barriers to yield, revealing the hidden treasures and mysteries beyond.

In One Thousand and One Nights , the inspiration for the set Arabian Nights , Ali Baba was a poor woodcutter who became rich after discovering a vast cache of treasure hidden by evil bandits. When first printed in Arabian Nights , Ali Baba had the unique Creature type of Ali Baba . This was given errata in the Grand Creature Type Update to be Human Rogue .
